short.name: Short proposal (stage 1, 2 pages)
tips: Stage 1 is a two-page short proposal: project, institution, PI/Co-PI; technical brief; deliverables and outcome (technology, prototype, algorithm, software); thrust area and relevance to naval labs.
NRB sends it to the relevant naval lab (NMRL, NSTL, NPOL, DMRL). Only if the lab shows interest are you asked for a detailed proposal and panel presentation.
The outcome must link to a DRDO or Services application. A PI may submit to only one research board.

detailed.name: Detailed proposal (ER/RB-01 format)
tips: Follow the ER/RB-01 detailed format and keep the naval lab's stated requirement at the centre of the objectives.
Name the naval lab that endorsed the short proposal and state what they will receive at each milestone.
